outcome: Receipt of VTE prophylaxis during delivery hospitalization
cohort: A total of 2,870,570 women hospitalized for either vaginal or cesarean delivery in the United States between January 2011 and March 2015.
finding: VTE prophylaxis for cesarean deliveries declined from 50.3% in 2011 to 47.7% in 2015, and delivery hospital was an important determinant of prophylaxis use.
mod_finding: VTE prophylaxis was administered to 47.7% of women undergoing cesarean delivery in 2015, while only 2.9% of women undergoing vaginal delivery received prophylaxis.
